reason: I already go through the PSA and the billing spreadsheet myself every month-end and I know my bigger clients from doing their QBRs, so I doubt you'd find much I don't already half-know. A free audit still costs me a 45-minute call plus an afternoon of exports, and I don't have that afternoon.
objection: It's my time and my client data for a free report that's really there to sell me £240 a month. Most of what it would flag I've let slide on purpose to keep clients sweet, and that won't change because a report says so.
would_change_my_mind: If you pulled the data straight from my PSA yourselves with read-only access, with no export work on my side, and another small MSP owner I trust told me it found them real money.
